questions.stem: Which of the following is a barrier method of preventing rust?

options.text: Making the iron into stainless steel
Attaching blocks of zinc to a ship's hull

questions.explanation: Painting is a barrier method because the paint forms a physical coating that keeps water and oxygen away from the iron surface, preventing rusting. Attaching zinc blocks and magnesium anodes are examples of sacrificial protection, while stainless steel is an example of alloying.
